title: Co-Writing Screenplays and Theatre Scripts with Language Models An Evaluation by Industry Professionals

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative feedback from expert participants (playwrights and screenwriters) during open-ended interviews after co-writing scripts with the language model, noting sexist tropes, misogynistic content, and stereotypical character roles (e.g., male protagonists vs. female supporting characters).
Qualitative feedback from expert participants identifying ageism in the generated script text during interactive co-writing sessions.

Qualitative feedback from expert participants discussing cultural appropriation, western-centric tropes, and the potential for the model to generate bigoted characters when prompted with ethnicity-specific names.
